games.title: My Platformer
games.note: Wall jumps and ledge hang: on a wall in the air, press A to jump off it (hold towards one wall and tap A each time you touch it to climb it). Fall past a wall's top edge holding towards it to hang: Up climbs on, A jumps, Down lets go. Try pillars 5 and 6 and the shaft behind the hanging block in the Playtest Room. Aiming: B fires the plug or pellet ahead, Up + B straight up, Up + Left/Right + B diagonally up.
